channel.title: Horn Updates — AI News Without the Noise
channel.description: Selected AI news and analysis covering models, agents, cybersecurity, business, policy and Africa & AI.

item.title: OpenAI's Data agent turns ChatGPT Work into an analytics layer
item.description: The new agent connects to company data, investigates business questions and can build interactive dashboards from a conversation.

item.title: ChatGPT for Financial Services brings premium data into AI workflows
item.description: OpenAI is packaging financial data, citations and GPT-6 Astra reasoning into a specialized version of ChatGPT Work.

item.title: Anthropic's new threat report shows how AI misuse is spreading across the cyber kill chain
item.description: Anthropic says it disrupted malicious uses of Claude involving cyber operations, surveillance, influence activity, fraud and illicit model distillation.

item.title: OpenAI backs mandatory national AI safety rules
item.description: OpenAI says Congress should adopt capability-based requirements while it continues supporting state legislation.

item.title: GPT-6 Astra raises the stakes for AI agents and cybersecurity
item.description: OpenAI's newest flagship model is designed for complex end-to-end work with stronger computer use, coding, research and cyber capability.
